rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: User logs showed entries with entry_zone=no_zone (e.g., TAOUSDT, ETHFI) which were causing losses. These entries lacked proper zone confirmation (FVG/OB) and were entering based on other signals alone.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: (1) Added quality_gate.reject_no_zone_entries=true to config.yaml, (2) Added check in _passes_signal_quality_gate that hard-blocks any signal with entry_zone='no_zone' when enabled, returning reason 'no_zone_blocked'
rca_of_the_issue.verification: After this fix, any signal with entry_zone='no_zone' will be rejected regardless of confidence/RR. Only signals with valid zones (fvg_bullish, fvg_bearish, ob_bullish, ob_bearish) will pass the quality gate.
